name: Ochiai-Minami-Nagasaki
tagline: Shinjuku in 12 minutes and Shibuya in 22 minutes. Served by 1 line. A one-room flat rents for roughly ¥70,000 to ¥80,000.
summary: The station is in Toshima City, served by Toei Oedo Line. Journey times to the main business districts are 32 minutes to Otemachi, 12 minutes to Shinjuku, 22 minutes to Shibuya and 43 minutes to Shinagawa. A one-room flat rents for roughly ¥70,000 to ¥80,000. The station stands 33 m above sea level, and the ground within 800 m varies in height by 8.7 m. The land around the station has gentle slopes.

terrain.note: The station sits on the higher side of the ground around it, at 33 m above sea level. Within 800 m the ground ranges from 28.7 m to 37.4 m, a difference of 8.7 m.

hazards: On the flood hazard map for the largest rainfall the government models, the station itself falls outside the projected inundation area. Even so, 3 of the nine points within 400 m fall inside the area, and the deepest projection there is less than 0.5 m. On the whole, the flood projection here is among the smallest in the 23 wards.

groceries.name: フードショップ埼玉屋

medical: Within an 800 m walk of the station there are 9 clinics and 6 pharmacies. Day-to-day care is available close to the station. The nearest hospital is 久木田医院, about 5 minutes' walk from the station. The next nearest is 本阿弥医院, about 6 minutes' walk. "Hospital" here means a facility OpenStreetMap records as one. OpenStreetMap does not record whether a facility admits inpatients or which departments it runs, so check each one on its own website. For which clinics open at night and at weekends, ask the emergency advice line of the ward you live in.
stationNote: 1 line serve the station: Toei Oedo Line.
congestion: Toei Oedo Line runs at 147% of capacity in the morning peak. The busiest stretch is 中井→東中野, which this station is not on. At 100%, the ministry's scale describes every passenger either seated or able to hold a strap or pillar. The figures describe each line's busiest stretch, so the stretch you ride may be easier.

rentRange.note: Around this station, One room ¥70,000 to ¥80,000 and 1K ¥90,000 to ¥100,000. 1LDK ¥140,000 to ¥150,000 and 2LDK ¥200,000 to ¥210,000. These are the per-station averages published by LIFULL HOME'S, Yahoo! Real Estate and at home, averaged together and rounded down to the nearest ¥10,000 (our own survey). All three are asking rents, so what tenants finally agree can be lower. Within the same station area the figure moves a great deal with the age of the building, the walk from the station, and whether the flat faces a main road.

rentReason: A one-room flat here goes for ¥70,000 to ¥80,000. Set against how long it takes to reach the central business districts, that is among the lowest in the 23 wards. What holds the figure down: only one line, the {line}, serving the station. For 2LDK, though, the sources differ by ¥30,000 or more. They count different sets of properties, so read those figures as a range rather than a point.

neighbours.lead: Higashi-Nagasaki is ahead on how little of the area is in the flood projection, but Ochiai-Minami-Nagasaki is ahead on the number of medical facilities and how easy the shopping is.
neighbours.note: Close enough to walk to from Ochiai-Minami-Nagasaki. Higashi-Nagasaki has the Seibu Ikebukuro Line, a different set from Ochiai-Minami-Nagasaki. To Roppongi, for instance, Higashi-Nagasaki takes 10 minutes longer. On how easy the shopping is, Ochiai-Minami-Nagasaki comes out ahead.

neighbours.lead: rents are lower at Ochiai-Minami-Nagasaki, but Nakai is ahead on the number of lines.
neighbours.note: About 1 km from Ochiai-Minami-Nagasaki in a straight line. Nakai also has the Seibu Shinjuku Line, which Ochiai-Minami-Nagasaki does not. With more lines, Nakai is the better connected of the two. To Otemachi, for instance, Nakai is 8 minutes quicker. A one-room flat, though, costs about ¥10,000 more at Nakai.

noiseSources: 目白通り (2 lanes each way) runs right beside the station, so for a flat close to the station, check whether it faces the road
新青梅街道 (a main road) runs just outside the station. In a flat facing it, the cars are audible morning and evening

leads.terrain: There are gentle slopes around the station, and which block you live on changes how much effort getting about takes.
leads.groceries: There are 7 supermarkets within walking distance, and the nearest is 2 minutes on foot.
leads.hazards: The station itself is outside the projected flood area, but blocks nearby are inside it.
leads.stationNote: Only the Toei Oedo Line serves this station, so when it stops you walk to another station.
leads.rentRange: Set against how long the commute takes, rents here are among the lowest in the 23 wards.
leads.medical: The number of clinics and pharmacies within walking distance is on the high side for the 23 wards.
leads.congestion: Morning loading on the lines here is about average for the 23 wards' stations.
leads.noiseSources: At this station, check the traffic noise before the noise people make.
